cli-dev-help.unix:
cd "$HOME/Downloads/openldr_ce"
pnpm openldr --help
pnpm openldr ingest --help
cli-dev-help.windows:
Set-Location C:\openldr_ce
pnpm openldr --help
pnpm openldr ingest --help

cli-en-2.unix:
pnpm openldr db reset --force
pnpm openldr db seed

cli-en-4.unix:
./openldr plugin install data/plugin.wasm
./openldr ingest data/results.sqlite --plugin whonet-sqlite
cli-en-4.windows:
.\openldr.ps1 plugin install data/plugin.wasm
.\openldr.ps1 ingest data/results.sqlite --plugin whonet-sqlite

cli-en-5.unix:
./openldr user create --username alice --name "Alice" --email alice@example.org --role lab_technician
./openldr user set-role ID lab_admin
cli-en-5.windows:
.\openldr.ps1 user create --username alice --name "Alice" --email alice@example.org --role lab_technician
.\openldr.ps1 user set-role ID lab_admin

cli-en-6.unix:
./openldr settings flags list
./openldr settings flags set dashboard.raw_sql true
cli-en-6.windows:
.\openldr.ps1 settings flags list
.\openldr.ps1 settings flags set dashboard.raw_sql true

cli-en-7.unix:
./openldr report list
./openldr report run ID

# PDF in the design's own text, then in French
./openldr report run ID --format pdf --out data/report.pdf
./openldr report run ID --format pdf --lang fr --out data/rapport.pdf
cli-en-7.windows:
.\openldr.ps1 report list
.\openldr.ps1 report run ID

# PDF in the design's own text, then in French
.\openldr.ps1 report run ID --format pdf --out data/report.pdf
.\openldr.ps1 report run ID --format pdf --lang fr --out data/rapport.pdf

cli-en-8.unix:
# On central: mint the lab's client + secret (printed once)
./openldr sync enroll lab-site-01 --central-url https://central.example.org

# On the lab: apply the credentials, then check status
./openldr settings sync set centralUrl https://central.example.org
./openldr settings sync set siteId LOCAL_SITE_ID
./openldr settings sync set oidcIssuer CENTRAL_ISSUER_URL
./openldr settings sync set clientId GENERATED_CLIENT_ID
./openldr settings sync set clientSecret GENERATED_CLIENT_SECRET
./openldr settings sync set mode bidirectional
./openldr settings sync set enabled true
./openldr sync status
cli-en-8.windows:
# On central: mint the lab's client + secret (printed once)
.\openldr.ps1 sync enroll lab-site-01 --central-url https://central.example.org

# On the lab: apply the credentials, then check status
.\openldr.ps1 settings sync set centralUrl https://central.example.org
.\openldr.ps1 settings sync set siteId LOCAL_SITE_ID
.\openldr.ps1 settings sync set oidcIssuer CENTRAL_ISSUER_URL
.\openldr.ps1 settings sync set clientId GENERATED_CLIENT_ID
.\openldr.ps1 settings sync set clientSecret GENERATED_CLIENT_SECRET
.\openldr.ps1 settings sync set mode bidirectional
.\openldr.ps1 settings sync set enabled true
.\openldr.ps1 sync status

cli-en-10.unix: ./openldr test-catalog list --search viral --category MOL --loinc linked --enabled on --json
cli-en-10.windows: .\openldr.ps1 test-catalog list --search viral --category MOL --loinc linked --enabled on --json

cli-en-11.unix:
./openldr test-catalog enable YOUR_TEST_CODE
./openldr test-catalog retire YOUR_TEST_CODE --json
cli-en-11.windows:
.\openldr.ps1 test-catalog enable YOUR_TEST_CODE
.\openldr.ps1 test-catalog retire YOUR_TEST_CODE --json

cli-en-12.unix:
./openldr test-catalog import data/national-tests.xlsx
./openldr test-catalog import data/national-tests.xlsx --value-map data/answers.json --apply
cli-en-12.windows:
.\openldr.ps1 test-catalog import data/national-tests.xlsx
.\openldr.ps1 test-catalog import data/national-tests.xlsx --value-map data/answers.json --apply

cli-en-15.unix:
./openldr test-catalog map list --status unmapped --json
./openldr test-catalog map set urn:openldr:disa SOURCE_CODE YOUR_TEST_CODE
./openldr test-catalog map clear urn:openldr:disa SOURCE_CODE --force
./openldr test-catalog map export --out data/mappings.csv
./openldr test-catalog map import data/mappings.csv
./openldr test-catalog map import data/mappings.csv --apply --force
./openldr test-catalog map rebuild --apply
cli-en-15.windows:
.\openldr.ps1 test-catalog map list --status unmapped --json
.\openldr.ps1 test-catalog map set urn:openldr:disa SOURCE_CODE YOUR_TEST_CODE
.\openldr.ps1 test-catalog map clear urn:openldr:disa SOURCE_CODE --force
.\openldr.ps1 test-catalog map export --out data/mappings.csv
.\openldr.ps1 test-catalog map import data/mappings.csv
.\openldr.ps1 test-catalog map import data/mappings.csv --apply --force
.\openldr.ps1 test-catalog map rebuild --apply

cli-en-16.unix:
./openldr test-catalog map list --level result --status unmapped
./openldr test-catalog map set urn:openldr:disa YOUR_RESULT_CODE YOUR_TEST_CODE --level result
./openldr test-catalog map match urn:openldr:disa
./openldr test-catalog map match urn:openldr:disa --apply --force
cli-en-16.windows:
.\openldr.ps1 test-catalog map list --level result --status unmapped
.\openldr.ps1 test-catalog map set urn:openldr:disa YOUR_RESULT_CODE YOUR_TEST_CODE --level result
.\openldr.ps1 test-catalog map match urn:openldr:disa
.\openldr.ps1 test-catalog map match urn:openldr:disa --apply --force

cli-en-17.unix:
./openldr test-catalog result-fields list --loinc none
./openldr test-catalog result-fields link YOUR_TEST_CODE 20447-9
./openldr test-catalog result-fields unlink YOUR_TEST_CODE --force
./openldr test-catalog result-fields export --out data/result-fields.csv
./openldr test-catalog result-fields import data/result-fields.csv --apply --force
cli-en-17.windows:
.\openldr.ps1 test-catalog result-fields list --loinc none
.\openldr.ps1 test-catalog result-fields link YOUR_TEST_CODE 20447-9
.\openldr.ps1 test-catalog result-fields unlink YOUR_TEST_CODE --force
.\openldr.ps1 test-catalog result-fields export --out data/result-fields.csv
.\openldr.ps1 test-catalog result-fields import data/result-fields.csv --apply --force

cli-en-18.unix:
./openldr market install data/BUNDLE_DIR --dry-run
./openldr market install data/BUNDLE_DIR
cli-en-18.windows:
.\openldr.ps1 market install data/BUNDLE_DIR --dry-run
.\openldr.ps1 market install data/BUNDLE_DIR
